tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `link`.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and sheets that sit on `surface-100`. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `link`.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: progress tracks, table stripes, quiet buttons on hover. Text on it: `ink` only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings and amounts on `surface-100`, `surface-200` and `surface-300`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and hints on `surface-100` and `surface-200`. Not on `surface-300`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs and the track of a progress bar. At least 3:1 on `surface-100` and `surface-200` in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The large leaf. Primary button fill, strong text accents. Navy in light, sand in dark.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill while hovered.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button fill while pressed.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-hover` and `brand-pressed`.

tokens.name: brand-2
tokens.usage: The middle leaf. Charts and secondary marks; on `surface-100` and `surface-200` it holds 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The small leaf, always the goal or the next step. Fill only, one per screen. Never text, and never a border on light grounds (1.9:1 on `surface-100`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and quiet buttons on `surface-100` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3 px solid with a 2 px offset. 3:1 or more on `surface-100` and `surface-200` in both themes.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Positive change in an amount, text on `surface-100` and `surface-200`. Always with a sign and an arrow.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative change and error text on `surface-100` and `surface-200`. Always with a sign, an arrow or the word Error.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled control. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; pair with `disabled-ink`.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text of a disabled control on `disabled-bg`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines and the wordmark at large sizes. Tracking −3 %.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above fields and amounts. Set the text in capitals.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The total on the home screen. Turn on tabular numbers.

styles.name: amount-m
styles.usage: Amounts in list rows. Tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones and default gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page bands.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a hero.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Progress bars and dividers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App icon tile at 64 px (22 % of its width).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A raised card on `surface-100`. One level only.
